NIKOLE HANNAH-JONES is the Pulitzer Prize-winning creator of the 1619 Project and a staff writer at The New York Times Magazine. She has spent her career investigating racial inequality and injustice, and her reporting has earned her the MacArthur Fellowship, known as the Genius grant, a Peabody Award, two George Polk Awards and the National Magazine Award three times. It is led by Pulitzer Prize-winning journalist Nikole Hannah-Jones , along with The New York Times Magazine editor-in-chief Jake Silverstein and The New York Times Magazine editors Ilena Silverman and Caitlin Roper.
